stemMd: A pump delivers 18 litres per minute. How many cubic metres does it deliver in 2 hours?
explanationMd: Two hours contain 120 minutes. The volume is $18\times120=2160$ litres. Dividing by 1000 converts litres to cubic metres, giving 2.16.
